decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch draws directly on the firm's woodworking, assembly and lighting know-how, so management can read its results and refine the models within its existing knowledge base.
The one-tier pyramid is a core Erzgebirge-style product fully within the firm's craft competence, so the firm can sustain and adapt it at low risk.

With the electronic music box line and its platform withdrawn, this Christmas motif platform has lost its complement and rests on electronic knowledge the firm lacks, so its resources are better returned to core pyramids and arches.
The Dresden-themed pyramid extends the firm's established pyramid craftsmanship and regional design knowledge, letting it interpret demand and improve the piece in-house.
